description: Records, fields, editors, adornments, validation and persistence

rows.feature: Record view shows the record label, tiered sections and backend-formatted values
scenarios: label heading
T1 header fields
T2 section cards
currency, grouped integer, Yes/No, date
negative: values match independent SQL readback

rows.feature: Empty values render a placeholder; hidden fields and hidden sections are never shown
rows.fixture: person 4 (NULL birth date); recordLab hiddenCode + hidden legacy section
scenarios: NULL date shows an em dash
hidden field absent from view and from the GET payload
hidden section not rendered
negative: hidden value stays stored (SQL)

rows.feature: Record view of a missing record shows Record Not Found and a way back
scenarios: not-found panel
back to the table list
negative: 404 read is the only failed request
no generic error toast

rows.feature: Record view tabs and list view expose every visible section
rows.fixture: fieldLab record created in the test
scenarios: Overview shows all T2 sections
a section tab shows only that section
list view shows every section

rows.feature: Create form validates required fields in the browser before any request
scenarios: required markers and messages for each required field
negative: no insert request, no row

rows.feature: Create persists the entered values and opens the new record
scenarios: success toast
navigates to /app/person/<new id>
view shows the entered values
negative: non-editable fields are not offered on create
row matches SQL readback

rows.feature: Backend enforces required fields when the UI is bypassed
source: qqq-backend-core InsertAction (Missing value in required field)
scenarios: direct insert without Name is rejected with the backend message
negative: no row written

rows.feature: Cancel from create and edit, with the unsaved-changes guard
scenarios: clean cancel returns immediately
dirty cancel asks Stay/Leave
Stay keeps typed values
Leave discards
negative: no insert or update request
no row created or changed

rows.feature: Edit loads stored values, saves only what changed, and shows the updated record
scenarios: fields prefilled from the record
Save disabled until a change
view shows the new value without reload
negative: only the changed field is submitted
other columns unchanged in SQL

rows.feature: Edit shows non-editable fields read-only and never submits them
scenarios: read-only controls with the stored values
negative: controls are disabled
create date unchanged in SQL after save

rows.feature: Edit of a missing record shows the load failure instead of a form
scenarios: error message, no form fields
negative: 404 is the only failed request

rows.feature: Delete asks for confirmation, removes the record and returns to the list without errors
scenarios: dialog names the record
Cancel keeps it
Delete removes it and returns to the list
success toast
negative: no Resource not found toast
no 404 read of the deleted record
row gone in SQL

rows.feature: Copy prefills a new record from the source and saves it as a separate record
scenarios: source values prefilled without the key
save creates a new row and opens it
source unchanged
negative: unique-key conflict on copy shows the backend message and keeps the form
download-URL files are not copied

rows.feature: STRING and TEXT editors round-trip single and multi-line text
scenarios: single-line input
multi-line textarea keeps line breaks in view and SQL

rows.feature: INTEGER, LONG and DECIMAL editors keep exact values
scenarios: LONG beyond 2^53 saved and shown exactly
DECIMAL with 4 places
negative: fractional LONG rejected in the browser
backend rejects a fractional LONG sent directly

rows.feature: BOOLEAN editor applies the metadata default and saves true/false
scenarios: create form starts at the default (true)
switching to false persists false
view shows Yes/No
negative: unchanged boolean is not rewritten on edit

rows.feature: DATE and TIME editors round-trip values and clearing
scenarios: date input value and view
time input value and backend 12-hour display
clearing a date stores NULL

rows.feature: DATE_TIME is entered and shown in the viewer's time zone and stored in UTC
scenarios: typed local time stored as the UTC instant
view shows yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss AM EDT
edit form shows the local time
negative: unchanged date-times are not rewritten
non-editable date-times read-only

rows.feature: Zoned DATE_TIME display behaviors (fixed zone and per-record zone)
scenarios: fixed America/Chicago display
display in the record's own timeZone
daylight-saving boundary
negative: invalid zone falls back to UTC

rows.feature: HTML field edits in the rich-text editor and renders sanitized
scenarios: formatted text rendered on the view
negative: script content is not executed

rows.feature: PASSWORD is masked on read and never overwritten by the mask
scenarios: view shows the mask
typing a new password saves it
negative: editing another field keeps the stored password (SQL)

rows.feature: BLOB upload and download without a download adornment
scenarios: file chosen on create is stored byte-for-byte
view offers the bytes as a download

rows.feature: Dynamic default values (user id, create day, modify day, explicit NONE)
scenarios: user id and dates filled on create
modify day updated on edit, create day kept
negative: NONE leaves the value empty

rows.feature: Max-length policies: truncate, ellipsis, pass-through and reject
scenarios: truncate, ellipsis and pass-through stored as declared
negative: reject shows the backend message, keeps the form and writes nothing

rows.feature: Case and whitespace normalization on save
scenarios: upper, lower, trim variants, remove-all-whitespace and unchanged stored as declared

rows.feature: Numeric range policies: reject, exclusive reject, inclusive clip and exclusive clip
negative: out-of-range and exclusive-boundary values show the backend message and write nothing

rows.feature: Unique keys are enforced with the backend message on create and edit
scenarios: distinct values save
negative: duplicate Name on create
duplicate normalized key on edit
form keeps values, row unchanged

rows.feature: LINK adornment: record links and URL links
scenarios: toRecordFromTable opens the referenced record
URL opens in a new tab (target _blank)
negative: a non-http value is not turned into a link

rows.feature: CHIP adornment colors and icons by value
scenarios: label is the display value
color from color.<value>
icon from icon.<value>
negative: undeclared value uses the default color

rows.feature: SIZE adornment sets the query grid column width
scenarios: column is 100px wide
negative: undeclared columns keep the default width

rows.feature: CODE_EDITOR adornment: code view with formatting and a code editor on forms
scenarios: view shows the code and its language
Format JSON / Reset Format
editor saves edited code
negative: invalid JSON reports a formatting error

rows.feature: RENDER_HTML adornment renders sanitized HTML
scenarios: markup rendered
negative: script removed and not executed

rows.feature: REVEAL adornment masks, reveals and copies the value
scenarios: masked by default
reveal shows the exact stored value
hide masks again

rows.feature: FILE_DOWNLOAD adornment links to the stored file with its name
scenarios: file name from the companion field
file name from the format
open and download return the stored bytes
negative: record without a file shows no link

rows.feature: FILE_UPLOAD adornment formats, replacing and removing a stored file
scenarios: drag-and-drop zone and button formats
current file shown on edit
new file replaces bytes and file name
negative: removing the file clears bytes and name

rows.feature: TOOLTIP adornment shows its text on the value
scenarios: tooltip on hover and keyboard focus

rows.feature: WIDGET adornment renders the field value as the named widget
scenarios: widget content from the record
negative: the value is not offered as an editable field

rows.feature: ERROR adornment highlights the value
scenarios: value shown with error styling

rows.feature: Field help content follows screen roles and formats
scenarios: view: READ_SCREENS text and VIEW_SCREEN HTML
edit: WRITE_SCREENS markdown rendered and EDIT_SCREEN text
create: INSERT_SCREEN text
negative: help for other screens is not shown

rows.feature: Section help content on the record view
scenarios: HTML help under the section heading

rows.feature: Table help content slots are delivered in table metadata
scenarios: v1 table metadata carries the slot help

rows.feature: Audit history lists who changed what, newest first
scenarios: edit then open Audit: message, user and per-field sentences
audit rows independently verified in SQL
negative: unaudited record shows no audits

rows.feature: Audit history without process permission reads the audit table
scenarios: same entries via the audit table query
negative: no process request is made

rows.feature: Record label format is used for the record's title and dialogs
scenarios: heading
delete dialog
audit title

rows.feature: Possible-value editor shows stored labels, looks up defaults and selects by keyboard
scenarios: edit shows the stored label, not the id
create default shows its label
keyboard search and select saves the id

rows.feature: Read-only persona sees no write actions and the backend refuses writes
scenarios: no Edit, Copy or Delete
create and edit URLs show the permission message
negative: direct insert, update and delete are 403 and change nothing

rows.feature: Forms are labelled and keyboard operable
scenarios: every control has a label
keyboard-only create saves the record
negative: invalid fields expose aria-invalid and a described error

rows.feature: Server validation errors show the backend message once and keep the form
scenarios: alert and toast show the backend message
typed values remain
negative: no generic Something went wrong toast

rows.feature: Record view hash links: #audit, #/launchProcess={process} and #{section} anchors
scenarios: #audit opens the audit dialog; closing it clears the hash and a reload does not reopen it
#/launchProcess=person.bulkEdit replaces the URL with the run for the record (init recordIds=2); Cancel returns to the record
#employmentInfo selects the Employment Info tab and scrolls it into view; a later hash change selects Dates

rows.feature: Create presets from links: #/createChild= opens a child create dialog over the record; /create#/defaultValues=/disabledFields= prefills and locks
scenarios: the backend-format #/createChild=pet link on person 3 opens Add Pet with Person preset and disabled; Create closes the dialog, clears the hash, submits personId=3 and SQL shows the pet linked to person 3
/app/pet/create#/defaultValues={name, personId}/disabledFields={personId} prefills both, locks Person and saves them (SQL)
/app/pet/create#defaultValues={speciesId} (no slash) prefills Species without locking
negative: locked fields are disabled; unlocked preset fields stay editable

rows.feature: Dependent possible values: a field whose filter uses ${input.otherField} offers only the choices matching the form's current values
rows.fixture: recPvPick itemId (recPvItem source filtered on categoryId = ${input.categoryId})
scenarios: every search posts the form values as the form-encoded values JSON
create: choices narrow to the chosen Category and change when it changes
edit: the stored Item label shows, a new Category changes the choices
the chosen id persists (SQL) and the record view shows its label
negative: Category empty: the unset variable makes no matches for a form, shown as No options found
an item outside the filter is not offered, even when searched by name
the backend refuses an out-of-filter id lookup and returns only the filtered choices

rows.feature: Table developer view shows the API Docs & Playground section for the table's application APIs
rows.fixture: stock sample tables (the sample classpath has no qqq-middleware-api, so no application APIs)
scenarios: developer page for a table keeps its metadata sections and shows the API Docs & Playground section
with no application APIs it shows "This table is not available in any APIs." and no API or Version selectors
negative: a viewer persona sees the same empty state and cannot fetch any table spec

rows.feature: Record developer view manages associated scripts: versions, new versions, test runs, logs, docs and script creation
rows.fixture: scriptLab (RecordsFixtures: Alpha with script 101, revisions 101-102, logs 101-102; Beta without a script) on the scripts tables from WidgetsFixtures
scenarios: versions list with CURRENT on the current revision and per-file code for the selected version; an older version offers Edit and Activate
save a new version with a commit message (SQL: new script_revision row, its file and script.current_script_revision_id; persists after reload)
test run output and log lines equal the backend testScript response; a failing run shows the error the backend returns
logs list the script_log rows of the selected version with their lines
docs show the script type help text and sample code
create a script for an empty associated script field
negative: a viewer cannot save or test a revision (no Edit or Test offered; the backend refuses storeScriptRevision and testScript)
a viewer cannot create a script (no Create Script offered; the backend refuses the create route)
a table without associated scripts shows none

rows.feature: Record view keyboard shortcuts n, e, c, d, a (Material) and their help text
scenarios: e, c and n open edit, copy and create with the right values
a opens the audit history; d opens the delete confirmation, Escape keeps the row (SQL), confirming deletes it (SQL)
? lists Create a New Record, Edit/Copy/Delete/Audit the current Record with their keys
negative: no shortcut fires while the audit or keyboard help dialog is open
keys typed in the Jump to input are text
viewer persona: n, e, c, d do nothing (a still works); the backend refuses insert and delete (403, SQL unchanged)
